Cambridge's tap water comes from underground 💧
99% of Cambridge Water's supply comes from aquifers and other groundwater, pumped from 24 boreholes in the chalk south and east of the city. Cambridge averages 585 mm of rain a year, and half of it needs to fall in winter to refill the chalk. A new Fens Reservoir is expected in supply between 2035 and 2037.

River, reservoir or ground: where does yours come from? Comment your guess 👇
